feature: 写作会话内 MCP 工具实时开关

coverage: Running task tool selections change without changing task id, status or worker lease
Independent toolsVersion rejects stale edits across windows
Worker output writes retain the latest tool permissions
Only individually selected and connection-authorized tools enter the model catalog
Real AI Services SDK requests reflect tools enabled or disabled between model turns
Revocation during initialization prevents tools/call dispatch
Revocation while a remote call is in flight discards its returned reference
Disabled calls return an explicit unavailable result instead of invented references

fixtures: UUID-isolated MySQL schema, local HTTP model fixture and in-memory MCP transport
deployment: Restart novel-ai and refresh author frontend. No database migration required.
boundary: Changes affect subsequent planning/checking model turns and tool permission checks. Already-dispatched remote requests cannot be recalled or refunded.
